## addStagedChangesToSarif() function

Adds the changes staged in a Git index, relative to a reviewed commit, to a copy of a SARIF document as fixes on the findings they belong to.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function addStagedChangesToSarif(input: IAddStagedChangesInput): Promise<AddStagedChangesOutcome>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[AddStagedChangesOutcome](./sarif-to-comment.addstagedchangesoutcome.md)<!-- -->&gt;

`added` with the new document and a receipt, `invalid` for input that is not schema-valid SARIF, or `failed`<!-- -->.

## Exceptions

`TypeError` for malformed input; an `Error` when Git cannot be run, the worktree is not in a repository, or the reviewed commit is not available locally.

## Remarks

Reads one snapshot of the index and the reviewed commit by blob identity; working-tree files, filters and hooks are never used, and nothing in the repository is changed. Applying the resulting replacements to the reviewed files reproduces the staged files exactly.

A finding receives a change only when its lines lie within the change's reviewed lines; neither is enlarged. Findings with their own fixes are never changed. A change no finding explains is added as a factual result in a new run attributed to this package. File creation and deletion become proposed file operations, which inspection shows but the current publisher refuses. Unsupported changes fail the whole call rather than being dropped.
